classification.difficultyReason: The hardest parts require converting rectangle perimeter into length plus width, or identifying a given difference as four ratio parts before finding the total. These link familiar facts with the taught unitary method without requiring a new insight.

inlines.text: Pink paint is made by mixing red and white paint in the ratio
How much of each colour is there if you need to make 51 L of paint?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3a, ratio bars above the equality scaffold
spec.description: Red has one square cell above White's two equal square cells, with left-aligned bar starts and an unlabelled right brace spanning both rows.
spec.mathematics: The bars represent red:white = 1:2, with three equal parts in total.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied category labels and unshaded bars are visible; no values or answers.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=51\text{ L}\\1\text{ part}&=51\div3=17\text{ L}\\2\text{ parts}&=2\times17=34\text{ L}\end{align*}$$
Red: 17 L; White: 34 L.

inlines.text: David, Jimmy, and Rex are paid to do some gardening.
They are to be paid in the ratio
If they are paid $72 in total, how much should each person receive?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3b, ratio bars above the equality scaffold
spec.description: David, Jimmy and Rex have two, three and four equal square cells respectively. Bars share their left start, and an unlabelled right brace spans all three rows.
spec.mathematics: The bars represent David:Jimmy:Rex = 2:3:4, with nine equal parts in total.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied names and unshaded bars are visible; no payment amounts or answers.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}9\text{ parts}&=\$72\\1\text{ part}&=\$72\div9=\$8\\2\text{ parts}&=2\times\$8=\$16\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times\$8=\$24\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times\$8=\$32\end{align*}$$
David gets \$16, Jimmy gets \$24 and Rex gets \$32.

children.label: e
children.prompt:
Two people share 63 in the ratio $2:5$.
Find the difference between their shares.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}7\text{ parts}&=63\\1\text{ part}&=63\div7=9\\\text{Difference in parts}&=5-2=3\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times9=27\end{align*}$$
The difference is 27.

answer.worked:

The smaller share is 18.

children.label: i
children.prompt:
The angles of a triangle are in the ratio $2:3:4$.
Find the angles.

answer.worked:
The angles of a triangle total $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}9\text{ parts}&=180^\circ\\1\text{ part}&=180^\circ\div9=20^\circ\\2\text{ parts}&=2\times20^\circ=40^\circ\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times20^\circ=60^\circ\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times20^\circ=80^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: j
children.prompt:
A rectangle has perimeter $54\text{ cm}$ and width : length $=2:7$.
Find its dimensions.

questionDiagrams.alt: Rectangle with l and w; w:l=2:7,\quad P=54\text{ cm}

spec.description: Unshaded rectangle with the given measurements, unknown side and ratio; not to scale.

answer.worked:
The width and length together are half the perimeter.
$$\begin{align*}w+l&=54\div2=27\text{ cm}\\9\text{ parts}&=27\text{ cm}\\1\text{ part}&=27\div9=3\text{ cm}\\\text{Width}&=2\times3=6\text{ cm}\\\text{Length}&=7\times3=21\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: k
children.prompt:
Two shares are in the ratio $3:7$. The smaller share is $24$.
Find the total.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=24\\1\text{ part}&=24\div3=8\\10\text{ parts}&=10\times8=80\end{align*}$$
The total is $80$.

children.label: l
children.prompt:
Two shares are in the ratio $3:7$. The difference is $20$.
Find the total.

answer.worked:
The difference represents $7-3=4$ parts.
$$\begin{align*}4\text{ parts}&=20\\1\text{ part}&=20\div4=5\\10\text{ parts}&=10\times5=50\end{align*}$$
The total is $50$.
